Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 10 pack code 340XV.

This Luceco FType Mk 2 is a flat, integrated LED downlight providing reliable, versatile lighting for various indoor installations. Power selectable between 4 and 6W, and colour selectable from warm 2700K to cool 6000K, it suits different environments from domestic kitchens and bathrooms to commercial offices and retail spaces. The fire-rated design ensures safety, while the IP65 rating makes it ideal for areas exposed to moisture. Installation is straightforward with SpeedFit housing and QuickView windows for secure wiring checks. Dimmable functionality allows for adjustable light levels, offering flexibility in any setting.
